response.reason: The exp(-|x|) formulation is mathematically exact for both signs (including ±0 → 0.5 and extreme values where exp underflows to 0 giving correct 0/1), uses round-to-nearest division and an explicit cvt.rn.f16.f32 for the final rounding, with correct masking/offset handling. The only theoretical concern is fp32 double-rounding when a true value sits within ~1 fp32 ulp of an fp16 midpoint, but no concrete failing input exists in the fp16 domain (the near-midpoint cases like x = k·2^-9 land on the same side after fp32 rounding), so the implementation satisfies the final-rounding contract.
